note: The VENUE's ceiling. Set once at setup; no show, fader, edit or bug may exceed it. Every frame that leaves portal/server.py is clamped by this AFTER the live trims are applied, so a trim can only ever ask for less. Where a limit makes an effect impossible the effect is not offered in the palette at all, rather than offered and then quietly clamped.

max_intensity.note: 0..1 per fixture group, applied to the par colour channels and the head dimmer. Heads are the ones that blind people.

strobe.note: allowed:false removes every strobing effect from the palette and forces the strobe channels to 0. max is the DMX ceiling when it is allowed (rig.py: the par's strobe channel runs to 25 Hz at 255).

keep_out.note: Pan angles the head must never light. Degrees from the wall centre, by rig.py's PAN_WALL_CENTRE=169 and PAN_DEG_PER_DMX=540/255. Inside a zone the head's dimmer is forced to 0: the fixture may travel through, it may not throw light there.
keep_out.name: the bar

max_rate.note: Largest change allowed between two consecutive 40 fps frames. Intensity is capped on the way UP only -- going dark fast is never the hazard, and a blackout has to be instant. null means no limit.
